# El Harmawy Business Consultancy F.Z.E (الهرماوي لاستشارات الأعمال)

> Business setup and government services consultancy in the UAE (Ajman Free Zone licence No. 58667). We help individuals and small companies with company formation in Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and the free zones (IFZA, Meydan, Ajman Free Zone), trade licences and renewals, corporate bank account assistance, MOHRE and immigration transactions, legal translation and certificate attestation, Saudi visas for GCC residents (with Amjad Tourism), accounting and bookkeeping. Arabic, English and Chinese. Founder: Ahmed Saeed El Harmawy, working in UAE business setup since 2013.

Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 346 9000 · info@elharmawy.com · https://elharmawy.com
Office: C1 Building, B.C. 1309081, Ajman Free Zone, Ajman, UAE
Approvals are decided by the competent UAE authorities. We are not a registered tax agent.

## Main services and current offers
- IFZA Dubai free zone licence: licence only AED 12,900; licence + 1 visa AED 16,900; licence + 2 visas AED 22,650. No office needed for the first 3 visas. https://elharmawy.com/ifza
- Dubai commercial licence (e-commerce, Noon & Amazon sellers, gifts, marketing, admin consultancy): AED 1,790 special price. https://elharmawy.com/dubai-trade-licence
- Saudi multiple-entry visa for GCC residents: AED 749, valid 1 year, stays up to 3 months, full refund if not approved. https://elharmawy.com/saudi-visa
- Certificate attestation and legal translation: written quote on WhatsApp, tracked to completion. https://elharmawy.com/attestation
- Track an ongoing transaction: https://elharmawy.com/track
